description:
Hi! 

I'm Johann Jomy, a Class 9 CBSE student passionate about space, technology and video games.

I want to create a Mars factory building game inspired by Factorio and Satisfactory, where players build bases, explore mineral deposits, research and upgrade their technology.

I know Python and C++ and have some experience with Godot and Unity. I'm looking for teammates interested in coding, game development, design and space exploration. Let's build something amazing together!
summary:
My project is a factory building video game where you will try to build bases on mars in which ores will be extracted by drills from the Martian surface. You will then do research on these ores and send research data back to earth to earn science points to further upgrade your base.

My goal with this project is to educate more people on how NASA plans to travel to and colonize other planets. I also hope that this project will make more people interested in space and technology.
